A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''woman''' of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] ancestry was one of two such women to give birth to at least one of four [[Youngling/Legends|children]] after [[Reproduction/Legends|being impregnated]] by the [[Morellian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and outdoorsman [[Barosa Warren]]. Among the children were the [[Gender/Legends|males]] [[Tole Warren]], [[Alton Lochner]], and [[Roland Warren]], and the female [[Danlea Lochner]], all Morellian&ndash;Human [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrids]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' states that the four children of Barosa Warren were from two Human mothers, but it fails to note which woman mothered which child. Similarly, it does not indicate whether Warren was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to either woman when the children were born. With no birth dates listed for the hybrid children, the source also leaves ambiguous the era in which each woman lived and coupled with Warren, whether during the latter years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], or both.<ref name="AIR" />
